text: Take a few akshintalu and a little water in your hand, and make the sankalpam with devotion.
"I, {name}, born in the {gotra} gotra, on this great day of Sharad Navaratri, worship Sri Durga Devi with devotion for the wellbeing, health, peace and good fortune of our family."
Then let the akshintalu fall into the puja plate.
